// V8's size limit (2^30 bits): a product past it throws before allocating;
// a shift lands exactly on the boundary; ** is a shift for a power-of-two base and an estimate within two bits otherwise (S137)
function t(name: string, f: () => unknown): void {
  try {
    console.log(name, f());
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof Error) console.log(name, e.name + ": " + e.message);
  }
}
const a = 1n << 600000000n;
t("mul", () => a * a);
t("mulNeg", () => -a * a);
t("mulSmall", () => (a * 3n) >> 599999999n);
t("shlEdge", () => (1n << (2n ** 30n - 1n)) > 0n);
t("shlOver", () => 1n << (2n ** 30n));
t("powOdd", () => 3n ** 1_000_000_000n);
t("powEst", () => 7n ** 383000000n);
t("pow2Neg", () => (-2n) ** 1073741823n > 0n);
t("pow2Over", () => 4n ** 536870912n);
t("pow2Edge", () => ((-8n) ** 3n) + (2n ** 64n));
t("powFits", () => (3n ** 200000n) % 1000000007n);
